question: Clock re-renders with a new time while you type in its <input>. What happens to your text?
options: It is copied into the h1
say: Clock re-renders with a new time while you type in its input. What happens to your text?
explanation: React only changes DOM nodes that differ. The input is in the same place, so React doesn't touch it.
explainSay: It stays. React does not touch the unchanged input.
